sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B-parameter reasoning model with only 2B active parameters, built for fast, private agents on-device. It is the largest and final model in the LFM2.5 family, which now spans two orders of magnitude: from LFM2.5-230M to LFM2.5-24B-A2B.

sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for Fast On-Device Agents - liquid.ai
sources.snippet: Today, we release LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a 24B-parameter reasoning model with just 2B active parameters, built for fast, private agents on-device. It is the largest and final model in the LFM2.5 family, which now spans two orders of magnitude: from LFM2.5-230M to LFM2.5-24B-A2B.

sources.title: mlx-community/LFM2-24B-A2B-4bit · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: Unlike LFM2-24B-A2B, LFM2.5-24B-A2B always thinks before it answers. The chat template opens every assistant turn with a <think> tag, so responses contain an explicit chain of thought before the final answer.

sources.title: LFM2-24B-A2B - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: LFM2 is a family of hybrid models designed for on-device deployment. LFM2-24B-A2B is the largest model in the family, scaling the architecture to 24 billion parameters while keeping inference efficient.
